# pltr space

Manage spaces

5 commands. Shared options (`--profile`, `--format`, `--output`, `--yes`, paging) are left out; [index.md](../index.md) explains the labels. Every option of one command: `pltr commands show <command>`.

### pltr space create

[beta] Create a space.

`pltr space create NAME --enrollment-rid TEXT --organization TEXT --deletion-policy-org TEXT [OPTIONS]`

- `NAME`: Display name of the new space.
- `--enrollment-rid`, `-e` TEXT (required): RID of the enrollment the space belongs to.
- `--organization`, `-org` TEXT (required; repeatable): Organization RID whose members get access to the space (repeat for several).
- `--deletion-policy-org`, `-dpo` TEXT (required; repeatable): Organization RID for the deletion policy: the space is deleted when the last of these organizations is (repeat for several).
- `--description`, `-d` TEXT: Description of the space.
- `--default-role-set-id` TEXT: Default role set for projects in the space (default: Foundry's).
- `--file-system-id` TEXT: Filesystem that stores the space's contents (default: Foundry's).
- `--usage-account-rid` TEXT: Usage account RID that the space's resource usage accrues to.
- beta · SDK: `filesystem.Space.create`

### pltr space delete

[beta] Delete an empty space (delete its projects and resources first).

`pltr space delete SPACE_RID [OPTIONS]`

- `SPACE_RID`: Space RID (find it with 'pltr space list').
- beta · **destructive** (asks first; `--yes` skips) · SDK: `filesystem.Space.delete`

### pltr space update

[beta] Change a space's name, description, default role set or usage account.

- `SPACE_RID`: Space RID (find it with 'pltr space list').
- `--name`, `-n` TEXT: New display name.
- `--description`, `-d` TEXT: New description.
- `--default-role-set-id` TEXT: Default role set for projects in the space (default: Foundry's).
